sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: German design duo KaschKasch collaborated with design brand Villeroy & Boch on a recycled ceramic material that is "technically precise and materially imperfect". Antao 3D aims to be the next evolution of ceramics' centuries-old history, where contemporary technological advances meet time-honoured craft.
